443:def exact_cftime_datetime_difference(a: CFTimeDatetime, b: CFTimeDatetime):
444:    """Exact computation of b - a
445:
446:    Assumes:
447:
448:        a = a_0 + a_m
449:        b = b_0 + b_m
450:
451:    Here a_0, and b_0 represent the input dates rounded
452:    down to the nearest second, and a_m, and b_m represent
453:    the remaining microseconds associated with date a and
454:    date b.
455:
456:    We can then express the value of b - a as:
457:
458:        b - a = (b_0 + b_m) - (a_0 + a_m) = b_0 - a_0 + b_m - a_m
459:
460:    By construction, we know that b_0 - a_0 must be a round number
461:    of seconds.  Therefore we can take the result of b_0 - a_0 using
462:    ordinary cftime.datetime arithmetic and round to the nearest
463:    second.  b_m - a_m is the remainder, in microseconds, and we
464:    can simply add this to the rounded timedelta.
465:
466:    Parameters
467:    ----------
468:    a : cftime.datetime
469:        Input datetime
470:    b : cftime.datetime
471:        Input datetime
472:
473:    Returns
474:    -------
475:    datetime.timedelta
476:    """
477:    seconds = b.replace(microsecond=0) - a.replace(microsecond=0)
478:    seconds = round(seconds.total_seconds())
479:    microseconds = b.microsecond - a.microsecond
480:    return datetime.timedelta(seconds=seconds, microseconds=microseconds)
